case_slice: Native discriminator for installed manual p199 versus p456 activated-branch failure timing

parent.acceptance: fixed-seed one-operated-of-three passive B-to-A-to-C source with TSWOV=0.5 h

model.repair: unchanged half-hour direct system CM after return

manual_conflict: Installed manual p199 says an activating block starts generating failures when switchover finishes; p456 says from initiation. A native event-level result can resolve observed failure timing for this configuration but not prove invisible internal clock creation or universal behavior.

discriminator_design.accepted_parent_events: B fails and B-to-A switch starts at h8.94145; TSWOV=0.5 finishes h9.44145; A fails h17.5636, 8.12215h after finish. The paired zero-time arm observed A failure at h17.0636.
discriminator_design.long_switch_if_b_stable: B-to-A starts around h8.94145 and finishes around h17.24145; the prior 8.12215h A interval is shorter than the 8.3h activation window.
discriminator_design.initiation_clock_hypothesis: If an A failure event is generated during activation using the same interval, it may appear near h17.0636, before switch completion; native event trace decides.
discriminator_design.completion_clock_hypothesis: If failure event generation waits for activation completion, A may fail near h25.3636; native event trace decides.
discriminator_design.interpretation_guard: Different random draws or disrupted branch selection require narrower interpretation; no predicted event time is preaccepted. A post-completion failure supports observable timing for this seed, not a universal statement about internal RNG calls.

acceptance_gates: frozen direct parent/source hashes and exact two-table delta; installed manual/dictionary/executable hashes
session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, host-wide native mutex, preserved GUI PID 13340, unique run directory
native import/export/calc/report, exact authored-row roundtrip, zero converter errors
native event timeline and System/Stock report bins reconciled against accepted parent by author and independent read-only reviewer
raw invocation, logs, model, report and closure SHA-256 seals in evidence index
limits: One fixed seed and repetition, one activated branch with an operating-hour failure mode, and one chosen 8.3-hour TSWOV do not establish population or all distributions/rates.
A native trace may establish observed event timing without revealing the internal failure-clock creation instant.
Remaining G05 priorities, unavailable standby, overlapping switches, nested propagation, GUI RBD rendering and cross-engine parity are separate work.
